title: The client and engine refuse recursive deletion of a lane or the shared .worktrees directory when it contains uncommitted or ignored files. Inside a lane they refuse only when the target covers tracked edits or untracked, unignored files, so ignored caches can be deleted. The engine also checks for active claims on a lane or any ancestor being deleted.
verification: Candidate tests compare both guards against real lanes for relative, absolute and cd-prefixed targets, whole lanes, the shared .worktrees directory and ignored caches. Engine tests also cover deleting an ancestor of a claimed lane. Installed relay proof is pending.
